description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing customer-related operations in a banking application, including fetching, adding, updating, and deleting customers.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: REST controller managing customer endpoints, wired with a banking service and annotated for Swagger documentation.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all customer details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new customer with provided details.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing customer details identified by customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer and associated accounts by customer number.
